## 更新内容

**正确性（本版重点）**

- **条件表达式不再重复求值已存储的调用。** `x = f(); if (x == null)` 的字节码是 `dup; astore; ifnull`；旧实现把调用表达式留在操作数栈上，条件里又打印一次 `f()`——`while (reader.readLine() != null)` 与循环体各读一次，MailcapFile 每轮消耗 3 行、AppleScriptEngine 2 行。现在分支读取刚写入的局部变量，且仅限紧随的条件分支（允许中间隔常量比较，如 `dup; istore; iconst_m1; if_icmpeq`），不存在「局部变量已被重新赋值」的风险。
- **布尔类型推断收紧。** 裸 `v == 0` 不再单独作为 boolean 的证据：javac 对 int 与 boolean 使用同一条测试指令，`int p = ports[i]; if (p == 0)` 以前会被声明成 `boolean p`（`boolean p = ports[i]` 根本无法编译）。现在要求 0/1 值域证据，并让明确的 int 生产点（调用结果、数组元素、int 字段/强转、算术）否决 boolean；`v = v & flag`、拷贝等歧义形态既不证明也不否决。
- 量化：把 rt.jar 中受影响的类重新交给 javac（`--release 8`，rt.jar 作 classpath），**327 个文件的编译错误减少、净减 2,695 条**；仅 1 个原本已损坏的文件增加 2 条；**没有新增语法错误文件**（jclassd 全量语法门禁仍是基线的 1 个——ASM 类名含 `()`，任何 Java 源码都无法拼写）。

**Java 27 / 28 支持**

- 解析 class 文件版本 71/72（Java 27/28），语料补入 Temurin 27+35 与 28-beta+18；完整 JDK 27/28 镜像反编译 0 失败，features 套件在两版各 10/10。

**其他缺陷修复**

- record 规范构造器不再输出非法的 `super();`。
- 被调用、却被 `--synthetic` 隐藏的 helper 不再删除（JetBrains 的 `$$$reportNull$$$0`）。
- `throw` 的合并值改用池感知的 LUB（此前退化成 Object）。
- 数组 checkcast 按描述符解析类型（此前 76 个单元把 `[Ljava/lang/Class;` 当成类名）。

**性能**

- CLI 改用 mimalloc 全局分配器；内部迁移到 jdc-core 0.2.17（`Arc<str>` IR、Fx 哈希）。
- 嵌套类反向引用索引改为**单飞构建**：此前每个渲染 worker 各建一次、全部争用类池互斥锁（JDK 28 镜像系统态时间 19.3s→11.1s）。
- 18 核 Apple M5 Pro：`rt.jar` 并行 **2.3s / 686MB**（单线程 9.4s / 427MB）；JDK 28 完整镜像（15,039 个单元）**4.7s / 978MB**（单线程 23.3s / 525MB）。
- 对比 Vineflower / CFR / Procyon / fernflower：`rt.jar` 上约 **11× / 23× / 48× / 93×**，JDK 28 镜像上约 **31× / 106× / 154×**（Vineflower 无法完成该负载）。
- 输出确定性保持不变：并行与 `JCDC_THREADS=1` 逐字节相同。

**验证**：features 59/59 × 两条结构化路径；语料 spot 与上一版逐方法字节一致；rt.jar 12,609 个单元全量、无 panic；jclassd 全量语法门禁 1 个（既有基线）。

## What's changed (English)

**Correctness (the headline of this release)**

- **Conditions no longer re-evaluate a call the store already performed.** `x = f(); if (x == null)` compiles to `dup; astore; ifnull`; the old builder left the CALL on the operand stack, so the branch printed `f()` a second time — `while (reader.readLine() != null)` above a body reading the same stream again (MailcapFile consumed three lines per iteration, AppleScriptEngine two). The store now rewrites the surviving duplicate to a read of the local it just wrote, restricted to the immediately-following conditional branch (constants in between are fine, e.g. `dup; istore; iconst_m1; if_icmpeq`), so a reassignment can never make the local stale.
- **Boolean inference tightened.** A bare `v == 0` is not boolean evidence on its own: javac has no distinct test opcode, so `int p = ports[i]; if (p == 0)` used to be declared `boolean p` — which does not even compile (`boolean p = ports[i]`). A boolean inference now also requires 0/1 value-range evidence, and an unambiguous int producer (call result, array element, int field/cast, arithmetic) vetoes it; ambiguous shapes (`v = v & flag`, copies) neither prove nor veto.
- Measured by recompiling the affected rt.jar classes with javac (`--release 8`, rt.jar as classpath): **327 files with fewer errors, −2,695 total**; one already-broken file gains 2; **no new syntax-error file** (the jclassd corpus gate stays at its baseline of 1 — ASM's class name containing `()`, unspeakable in Java source).

**Java 27 / 28 support**

- Class-file versions 71/72 are parsed; Temurin 27+35 and 28-beta+18 are in the corpus. Full JDK 27/28 images decompile with 0 failures; the features suite is 10/10 on each.

**Other fixes**

- Record canonical constructors no longer emit an illegal `super();`.
- Called helpers hidden by `--synthetic` are no longer dropped (JetBrains `$$$reportNull$$$0`).
- Merged `throw` values take a pool-aware LUB instead of degrading to Object.
- Array checkcasts resolve their type from the descriptor (76 units previously treated `[Ljava/lang/Class;` as a class name).

**Performance**

- mimalloc as the global allocator; internal migration to jdc-core 0.2.17 (`Arc<str>` IR, Fx hashing).
- The nested-class reverse-reference index is built **once per pool** instead of once per render worker (JDK 28 image: kernel-side time 19.3 s → 11.1 s).
- Apple M5 Pro, 18 cores: `rt.jar` **2.3 s / 686 MB** parallel (9.4 s / 427 MB single-threaded); full JDK 28 image (15,039 units) **4.7 s / 978 MB** (23.3 s / 525 MB single-threaded).
- Against Vineflower / CFR / Procyon / fernflower: ~**11× / 23× / 48× / 93×** on `rt.jar`, and ~**31× / 106× / 154×** on the JDK 28 image (Vineflower cannot finish it).
- Deterministic output is unchanged: parallel and `JCDC_THREADS=1` runs are byte-identical.

**Verification**: features 59/59 on both structurer paths; corpus spot byte-identical per method to the previous release; rt.jar 12,609 units, panic-free; jclassd syntax gate at its baseline of 1.
